body:
What about specifying the type here? Like: 

``` js
Usage: hits({container: DOMElement | string, [templates: Object{ empty: string | function, hit: string | function}, transformData: Object {empty: function, hit: function}, hitsPerPage: number]})
```
Primitive types in JS are lower case. Maybe we should update the doc to reflect that. Also probably out of the scope of this PR.
